console.customerNotificationsDesc: The emails your store sends customers. Edit any template, preview it, send yourself a test, or revert to the default.
console.senderDesc: Your store's emails are sent from the platform's address with this one as the reply-to, so customers' answers reach you here.
console.smsDesc: Text an order confirmation when a customer checks out with a phone and no email.
console.subject: Email subject
console.liquidHint: Use Liquid variables like '{{ order_name }}' and '{{ total_price | money }}'.
console.verifySuccessDesc: Customers' replies to your store's emails will reach you at this address.
console.verifyErrorDesc: This link is invalid, already used, or expired. Request a new one from Settings → Notifications.

eventDesc.order_confirmation: Sent when a customer places an order
eventDesc.order_invoice: Sent when an order has an outstanding balance
eventDesc.shipping_confirmation: Sent when you mark an order as fulfilled
eventDesc.order_canceled: Sent if a customer cancels their order
eventDesc.order_payment_expired: Sent when an unpaid order is canceled because its payment was not completed in time
eventDesc.transfer_rejected: Sent when you reject a bank-transfer receipt. A customer who ordered in a chat is told in that chat instead
eventDesc.order_completed: Sent when an order is complete
eventDesc.order_refund: Sent if an order is refunded
eventDesc.shipping_update: Sent when you add or update an order tracking number
eventDesc.out_for_delivery: Sent when an order with a tracking number is out for delivery
eventDesc.delivered: Sent if an order with a tracking number is delivered
eventDesc.back_in_stock: Sent when a viewed item is back in stock
eventDesc.return_requested: Sent to confirm a customer's self-serve return request was received
eventDesc.return_approved: Sent when you approve a return request
eventDesc.return_declined: Sent when you decline a return request
eventDesc.account_welcome: Sent when a customer completes their account activation
eventDesc.account_invite: Sent when you invite a customer to create an account
eventDesc.password_reset: Sent when a customer requests to reset their account password
eventDesc.store_credit_issued: Sent when a store credit amount is credited to the customer's account

console.channelsDesc: Email always goes out when the customer left an address. These are the extra channels, each off until you turn it on.
console.channelsWhatsAppDesc: Send order updates on your connected number. Reaches customers who checked out with a phone number.
console.channelsTelegramDesc: Send order updates on your shop's bot. Reaches only customers who have opened a chat with it and signed in — Telegram does not let a bot message anyone else.

staff.title: Staff notifications
staff.desc: Team members who get an email when a new order comes in.

menu.customerDesc: Notify customers about order and account events
menu.staffDesc: Notify staff members about new order events
menu.fulfillmentDesc: Notify your fulfillment service provider when you mark an order as fulfilled
menu.fulfillmentBody: This notification is sent to your fulfillment service provider when you mark an order as fulfilled. It's not configurable yet.
menu.webhooksDesc: Send XML or JSON notifications about store events to a URL

digest.title: Store order summary
digest.desc: A summary of your store's orders, sales, and top products, emailed to staff subscribed to it.

prefs.intro: Choose how you want to be notified. In-app shows in the bell; email sends a copy to your account address.

hub.deliveryEmail: Email notifications are sent to your account address.
hub.deliveryInApp: In-app notifications appear in the bell at the top of every page.
hub.typesSubtitle: Choose which events notify you, and through which channel.

typeDesc.ORDER: New orders, cancellations, and status changes.
typeDesc.REFUND: When a customer requests a refund.
typeDesc.INVENTORY: Low-stock and out-of-stock alerts for your products.
typeDesc.REVIEW: When a customer leaves a review on a product.
typeDesc.STORE_NOTICE: Announcements and notices posted to your store.
typeDesc.MESSAGE: New customer messages sent to your store.
typeDesc.BILLING: Your subscription — a trial ending, a card that failed, a plan that lapsed.
